issuer: the Uganda Driver Licensing System (UDLS), for the Ministry of Works and Transport
note: Read 2026-10-30 on udls.co.ug, the Uganda Driver Licensing System's own site (payments go through the URA or the Ministry of Works and Transport's e-services portal). A new full driving licence is priced by its validity: five years UGX 330,000, three years 230,000, one year 135,000; until 2026-10-30 the five-year licence was held alone (fee and term together); from then the three are held as the terms the holder chooses, one year at UGX 135,000, three at 230,000 and five at 330,000. The learner/provisional licence (three months, UGX 60,000) and the driving test fee aren't the full licence's and aren't held. The age: the exchange page says the minimum age to receive a driving licence under Ugandan law is 18, so the licence is held from 18 (the Traffic and Road Safety Act itself, on ULII, answered a bot check and wasn't read). A foreign licence may be exchanged by its holder; no list of countries is given, so no exchange list is held. No identity card is held.

sources.title: Uganda Driver Licensing System, Driving licence fees
sources.said: All payments for services are made via the URA website or the Ministry of Works and Transport e-services portal ... Get a new full driving licence The fee depends on the validity period of the licence. ... Five years 330,000 Three years 230,000 One year 135,000 ... This costs Shs60,000 and is valid for three months.

sources.title: Uganda Driver Licensing System, Exchange a foreign driving licence
sources.said: All foreign conversion applicants should have received their driving licence at the minimum required 18 years of age as set out by Ugandan law.
